events.text:
SCORESTREAK CHANGES (TO PHAM'S KNOWLEDGE):
- new ScoreStreak + Multipler group, with CheckMultiplier function
- new ScoreGain and ScoreMultipler Variable
- on correct trash sorted:
    - Don't add 1 to Score anymore. Instead, add (ScoreGain * ScoreMultiplier) to Score.
    - Add 1 to ScoreStreak
    - Call CheckMultiplier
- on incorrect trash sorted:
    - Set ScoreStreak to 0
    - Set ScoreMultiplier to 1
    - Set ScoreStreakTracker to False
- in Hearts Tracking Logic (IMPORTANT!!! ScoreStreak won't work otherwise!!)
    - Delete "ScoreStreakTracker = 0" condition
